book.cc_aeroworks.page_1:
CC-Aeroworks

Each connected desk remains an addressable adapter. The embedded computer combines all desks and their neighbouring peripherals into one searchable network.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_2:
Controls

Open computer:
Sneak + right-click, empty main hand.

Operate control:
Normal right-click on the module.

Settings:
Wrench a horizontal desk side.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_3:
Desk network

Same-facing desks connect left and right. The embedded computer may occupy any position. A network may contain only one embedded computer and at most 64 loaded desks.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_4:
Local adapter

local desk = peripheral.find("ControlDesk")
local modules = desk.getModules()

An external computer accesses each directly connected desk as its own local peripheral.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_5:
Embedded computer

local desks = peripherals.find("ControlDesk")
local modem = peripherals.find("endermodem")

A type which occurs once is returned directly. Use findAll for a stable collection.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_6:
Displays

Raw: desk.setDisplayText("big", "123")
Reactive UI: require("cc_aeroworks.ui")

Pixel resolution is configurable; Reactive UI updates only dependent regions and changed tiles.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_7:
Radar Display

Use the Create: Radars Data Link on a Network Filterer, then on the desk carrying the Radar Display. Create: Radars places the physical link block and registers that desk as a monitor endpoint. Removing the link disconnects it.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_8:
Diagnosis

local network = peripherals.getNetwork()
for kind, count in pairs(peripherals.getTypes()) do print(kind, count) end

Use peripherals.refresh() after a capability changes without a block update.
guide.cc_aeroworks.title: CC-Aeroworks Handbook
guide.cc_aeroworks.start.title: Build an addressable desk network
guide.cc_aeroworks.start.text: Same-facing desks form one network of independent adapters. Exactly one embedded Computer Control Desk adds the global peripherals API and can be placed at any position in the row.
guide.cc_aeroworks.start.controls: Open Ponder: Hold W over a Computer Control Desk, display or Radar Display in an inventory or recipe viewer.
guide.cc_aeroworks.start.note: An external CC:Tweaked computer still sees the directly attached ControlDesk adapter. The embedded computer additionally indexes every neighbouring peripheral across the complete desk network.
guide.cc_aeroworks.computers.title: Use Computer Control Desks
guide.cc_aeroworks.computers.text: Normal and advanced Computer Control Desks retain the computer ID, label, terminal size and desk modules. Their position does not alter which desks or neighbouring peripherals are visible.
guide.cc_aeroworks.computers.controls: Terminal: Sneak + right-click with an empty main hand. Control: normal right-click. Settings: Wrench a horizontal desk side.
guide.cc_aeroworks.computers.warning: A network may contain at most one embedded computer. If another is placed accidentally, a normal desk remains and the additional computer is ejected with its data.
guide.cc_aeroworks.computers.note: The six physical computer sides remain local. The peripherals API provides the additional multiblock-wide view without pretending every remote device occupies a computer side.
guide.cc_aeroworks.network.title: Peripheral graph and type lookup
guide.cc_aeroworks.network.text: peripherals.find(type) returns nil for no match, the direct handle for one match, and a position-keyed table for several matches. peripherals.findAll(type) always returns a table. ControlDesk always returns the complete desk table.
guide.cc_aeroworks.network.note: Type matching is case-insensitive and also accepts compact forms such as endermodem for ender_modem. A full namespaced type remains available when short aliases collide.
guide.cc_aeroworks.modules.title: Sockets, modules and local adapters
guide.cc_aeroworks.modules.text: Each Desk handle exposes sockets, modules, inputs, displays and peripherals attached to its six faces. Use desk.find(type) for one desk or peripherals.find(type) for the whole network.
guide.cc_aeroworks.modules.note: Local input changes use cc_aeroworks_desk_input. Graph refreshes emit cc_aeroworks_peripheral_attached and cc_aeroworks_peripheral_detached with the network address and primary type.
guide.cc_aeroworks.displays.title: Direct text, number and pixel control
guide.cc_aeroworks.displays.text: The Raw Display API remains available for simple instruments and direct pixel control. The server config defines each display size's pixel resolution and programs must read it through getDisplaySize. Reactive UI is intended for interactive or data-driven MFDs.
guide.cc_aeroworks.displays.note: Pixel coordinates start at 1,1 in the upper-left corner. Complete raw grids must match the configured dimensions exactly. Reactive UI runtime frames are transient and synchronized as tiles instead.
guide.cc_aeroworks.pixel_editor.title: Build a pixel grid and Lua code
guide.cc_aeroworks.pixel_editor.text: Choose the display size, socket and pixel state. Left-click draws with the selected state and right-click erases. The editor uses the currently synced display resolution and never changes a display in the world.
guide.cc_aeroworks.pixel_editor.note: The raw method contract writes boolean pixel states. The raster dimensions are configuration values and must be read instead of assumed.
guide.cc_aeroworks.controls.title: Controls and settings
guide.cc_aeroworks.controls.text: A normal right-click operates Aeroworks controls. Right-click a horizontal desk side with a Create Wrench to open the control overview. Combined can be selected there for each supported axis.
guide.cc_aeroworks.controls.input: In Combined mode click the centre field, capture a key or mouse button, then look at the module, hold the key and move the mouse.
guide.cc_aeroworks.controls.note: Releasing the key, opening a menu, losing focus or losing the target ends combined control immediately.
guide.cc_aeroworks.errors.title: Network and UI diagnostics
guide.cc_aeroworks.errors.text: Check the desk network state first. For Reactive UI, ui.dependencies() shows which state or data sources are attached to which composition, layout or draw scopes.
guide.cc_aeroworks.errors.warning: find changes its return shape when the match count changes. Use findAll whenever code must always iterate a collection.
guide.cc_aeroworks.errors.note: For display problems, check resolution, controller and boot paths, then registered dependencies. An unchanged derived value deliberately should not create a new frame.
guide.cc_aeroworks.reactive.intro.label: Introduction
guide.cc_aeroworks.reactive.intro.title: Declarative display applications
guide.cc_aeroworks.reactive.intro.text: Reactive UI describes what should be visible on a display. One supervisor loads configured boot programs, retains components and state, and redraws only when state read by the UI becomes invalid.
guide.cc_aeroworks.reactive.intro.note: The large display module menu stores the controller script and boot program separately. The controller processes input; the boot program describes the initial screen. /cc_aeroworks/display_runtime.lua starts every configured display on an embedded computer.
guide.cc_aeroworks.reactive.state.label: State & Data
guide.cc_aeroworks.reactive.state.title: State, derived state and automatic dependencies
guide.cc_aeroworks.reactive.state.text: ui.state automatically registers reads on the active restart scope. ui.derived recalculates when its inputs are invalidated and propagates only if its result actually changes. Use ui.telemetry instead of the raw telemetry API when telemetry should be tracked automatically as a UI dependency.
guide.cc_aeroworks.reactive.state.note: A tank source may change internally more often than its rounded percentage. If derived state stays equal, dependent UI nodes are not redrawn.
guide.cc_aeroworks.reactive.layout.label: Layout & Components
guide.cc_aeroworks.reactive.layout.title: Invalidate composition, layout and draw separately
guide.cc_aeroworks.reactive.layout.text: Column, Row and Box form a retained UI tree. Reads in composition can change node structure, reads in layout can change sizes and positions, and reads in draw only affect rendering. The runtime keeps separate restart scopes for these phases.
guide.cc_aeroworks.reactive.layout.note: Text without a fixed width reads its content during layout because text length affects its size. A ProgressBar value is read only during draw and can update without a new layout pass.
guide.cc_aeroworks.reactive.navigation.t: ui.navigator and ui.Route switch declaratively between screens. Buttons and other interactive nodes are hit-tested from their calculated bounds. A separate controller script can process pointer events before the UI and switch to another display app by returning its path.
Limit work by dependency and dirty tiles

Runtime frames are stored as sparse 64x64 tiles. A commit compares tiles against the previous frame and synchronizes only changed tiles. For draw-only invalidations, only the affected rectangle is cleared and rasterized again.

Configured total resolution defines the coordinate surface, not automatically the cost of every update. Cost is driven mainly by retained nodes, affected draw bounds and pixels which are actually enabled.
guide.cc_aeroworks.data.sources.label: Reactive Sources
guide.cc_aeroworks.data.sources.title: Data sources as revisioned state
guide.cc_aeroworks.data.sources.text: Telemetry already provides stable source IDs and revisions. Reactive UI associates a source read with the active restart scope. A source event therefore invalidates only UI regions which actually read that source.
guide.cc_aeroworks.data.sources.note: The dependency system is intentionally generic. Future information sources such as storage, radar or navigation can use the same source:<id> mechanism instead of inventing their own polling loops.
guide.cc_aeroworks.api.overview.label: Overview
guide.cc_aeroworks.api.overview.title: APIs and access paths
guide.cc_aeroworks.api.overview.text: The embedded computer exposes several global modules: peripherals for the desk network, controls for control authority, telemetry for information sources and ui for reactive display applications. An external CC:Tweaked system still receives only the directly connected ControlDesk adapter.
guide.cc_aeroworks.api.overview.note: The old global aeroworks API is not part of the current contract. Reference pages are generated from one structured registry so method names do not age independently from the handbook.
guide.cc_aeroworks.api.control_desk.summ: The ControlDesk adapter addresses exactly one desk with its sockets, modules, inputs and direct Raw Display API. External computers see only directly connected desks; the embedded computer additionally receives network-wide desk handles.
guide.cc_aeroworks.api.peripherals.label: peripherals
guide.cc_aeroworks.api.peripherals.title: Global peripherals API
guide.cc_aeroworks.api.peripherals.summa: peripherals searches the complete active desk multiblock for desks and neighbouring CC:Tweaked peripherals and exposes stable addresses and handles.
guide.cc_aeroworks.api.controls.label: controls
guide.cc_aeroworks.api.controls.title: Control authority and overrides
guide.cc_aeroworks.api.controls.summary: controls exists only on the embedded computer and may take over or release continuous Aeroworks control channels. Effective values and visible module positions stay coupled through Aeroworks' normal setter.
guide.cc_aeroworks.api.telemetry.label: telemetry
guide.cc_aeroworks.api.telemetry.title: Telemetry and Display Link data
guide.cc_aeroworks.api.telemetry.summary: telemetry exposes structured Create Display Link sources, revisions, docking and change events. Read the same data through ui.telemetry when automatic Reactive UI dependencies are required.
guide.cc_aeroworks.api.ui.label: ui
guide.cc_aeroworks.api.ui.title: Reactive Display UI
guide.cc_aeroworks.api.ui.summary: ui is the embedded computer's declarative display library. It manages state, restart scopes, layout, hit testing, navigation and transient tiled runtime frames; ui.supervise starts every display with a configured boot program.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.desk_network.text_1: The Computer Control Desk is one addressable adapter and hosts the embedded computer.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.desk_network.text_2: Same-facing desks connect left and right, but every desk keeps its own position, modules and attached devices.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.desk_network.text_3: The computer may stand at the left, middle or right end without changing network access.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.desk_network.text_4: Together the adapters form one searchable peripheral graph.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.desk_network.text_5: Sneak and right-click any loaded desk with an empty hand to open the embedded terminal.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.desk_network.text_6: Only one embedded computer may own a network of up to 64 fully loaded desks.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.peripheral_search.te: A peripheral on this face belongs to the middle Desk adapter.
Devices on other desks keep their own desk address and attachment side.
The embedded computer indexes all of them in the global peripherals API.
local modem = peripherals.find("endermodem") returns the direct handle when that type occurs once.
With several matches, find returns a table keyed by desk position and side.
Use peripherals.findAll(type) when a program must always receive a collection.
ControlDesk is special: peripherals.find("ControlDesk") always returns every desk by position.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.diagnostics.text_1: Two embedded computers create a conflict and disable global graph access.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.diagnostics.text_2: Normal placement keeps one computer and ejects an accidental duplicate with its data.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.diagnostics.text_3: Partially loaded or overlong desk rows are rejected instead of loading chunks silently.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.diagnostics.text_4: peripherals.getNetwork() reports state, revision, desk count and peripheral count.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.diagnostics.text_5: After a capability-only change, peripherals.refresh() rebuilds the graph and emits attach or detach events.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.display_crafting.tex: A Normal Monitor becomes the small desk display under a Mechanical Press.
An Advanced Monitor becomes the large desk display in the same process.
Both results are programmable display modules, not standalone monitor blocks.
Radar variants use the corresponding display plus a Create: Radars monitor in a Deployer recipe.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.display_mounting.tex: Two small displays may occupy the left and right sockets together.
A small display also fits the big socket.
The large display fits only the big socket.
Each display remains part of its Desk handle and can be addressed from anywhere in the desk network.
Mount the display in the desk whose position will be used as its address.
local desks = peripherals.find("ControlDesk") selects desks by their x,y,z key.
desk.setDisplayText("big", "123") and setDisplayNumber switch to text mode.
Read getDisplaySize before writing pixels because the configured resolution is not fixed.
Pixel methods switch to raster mode; clearDisplay returns to an empty text display.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.radar_controller.hea: Linking a Radar Display as a native monitor
ponder.cc_aeroworks.radar_controller.tex: Mount a small or large Radar Display in the desk that should become the monitor endpoint.
Use the Create: Radars Data Link on the Network Filterer first; the item stores that network source.
Use the same item on the Radar Display desk. A desk without a Radar Display is not accepted.
Create: Radars performs the range check and places its physical Data Link block on the desk.
The desk is now registered in the group's monitorEndpoints like a native monitor.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.radar_direct.header: Using and removing the native desk endpoint
ponder.cc_aeroworks.radar_direct.text_1: Every five ticks the linked desk resolves its filterer and radar from NetworkData.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.radar_direct.text_2: The Radar Display uses the group's DetectionConfig and selected target, not an unfiltered world scan.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.radar_direct.text_3: Background, sweep, filtered contacts and the selected target render on this endpoint only.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.radar_direct.text_4: Additional Radar Display desks need their own physical Data Link blocks, even in the same desk network.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.radar_direct.text_5: Breaking the physical Data Link lets Create: Radars remove the endpoint and the display shows the disconnected X.
